_comment: Copy this to config.json next to SKILL.md and fill in your own values. Every key is optional - the defaults below are what the skill uses when a key is missing, so it runs on a fresh clone with no config.json at all. Any key can also be overridden for one run with a LEARN_<KEY> environment variable, e.g. LEARN_VAULT_ROOT.
_vault_root: absolute path to the Obsidian vault (or any notes folder) the skill writes into. Every other path in this file is relative to it. Default: the current directory.
_surface: where the learner reads and answers. 'obsidian' (the default) puts the session note in Obsidian on the left and takes answers in the terminal on the right - no extra dependency. 'podium' renders the same note into a Lavish page and takes the answers on the page itself; it needs `lavish-axi` on PATH (npm i -g lavish-axi). The note is the durable record either way, and every tool takes the same arguments on both. Default: obsidian.
_obsidian_vault_name: the vault's name as Obsidian knows it - the last path segment of vault_root, unless you renamed the vault inside Obsidian. Used to build the obsidian://open URI. Default: the basename of vault_root.
_learning_dir: vault-relative folder for session notes that do not belong to a course. Default: Learning.
_course_learning_dir: vault-relative pattern for a course's session notes. {course} is replaced with the course folder name exactly as it appears on disk. Leave empty if you do not organise by course. Default: empty.
_learner_file: vault-relative profile note: who is being taught, and what they have already demonstrated. Read before every probe, appended to at the end of every session. Default: <learning_dir>/LEARNER.md.
_quiz_log_dir: vault-relative folder for quiz.py's answer-key sidecars and its graded-answer log. A dot folder so Obsidian ignores it. Default: <learning_dir>/.quiz-log.
_visuals_dir: vault-relative folder for SVG diagrams embedded in session notes. Default: <learning_dir>/visuals.
_chrome_path: absolute path to a Chrome or Chromium binary. Both render tools drive it headless. Default: the first of the usual per-platform install paths that exists, then chrome/chromium on PATH.
_terminal_process: process name of the terminal you answer in, for layout.ps1. Default: the first of WindowsTerminal, wezterm-gui, alacritty, conhost that is running.
